report.summary: Alert EVAL-12 reported by EDR on host WS-IT-01 indicates a burst of discovery commands executed via PowerShell under user CORP\it-admin. Historical data shows an identical past alert on the same host resolved as a benign true positive.

claims.text: The alerting tool reported that discovery commands were executed in quick succession on host WS-IT-01.
PowerShell was started by explorer.exe as user CORP\it-admin between 2026-11-10T14:00:00+00:00 and 2026-11-10T14:02:20+00:00.
whoami.exe was executed via PowerShell with the command line whoami /all.
net.exe was executed via PowerShell with the command line net group "domain admins" /domain.
nltest.exe was executed via PowerShell with the command line nltest /dclist:corp.
Host WS-IT-01 has a past alert PA-2026-0922 involving a burst of discovery commands that was resolved as a benign true positive.

recommended_next_steps: Verify if CORP\it-admin intended to run these discovery commands for administrative tasks.
Check for any follow-on activity or anomalous lateral movement from WS-IT-01.
Review past alert PA-2026-0922 documentation to confirm similar administrative context.
Tune detection rules for WS-IT-01 if this routine IT discovery activity occurs frequently.
